Z-score standardization.

Transforms features to have mean=0 and std=1.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Category | [Preprocessing](../categories/preprocessing.md) |
| Status | Runs |
| Also read from graphs as | `StandardScaler` |
| Search words | standardize, zscore, scaler |

| Pin | Type | Required | Connections | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Data** | Dataset | Yes | 1 | Input data |

## Outputs

| Pin | Type | Required | Connections | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Scaled** | Dataset | Yes | 1 | Standardized data |

## Settings

| Group | Setting | Key | Type | Default | Allowed values | Read by | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
|   | columns | `columns` | Text | (empty) |   | The run | Columns to scale (empty = numeric auto-detect) |
|   | label_col | `label_col` | Text | (empty) |   | The run | Label column to exclude. |
|   | exclude_columns | `exclude_columns` | Text | (empty) |   | The run | Additional columns to exclude from numeric auto-detect (comma-separated) |
|   | with_mean | `with_mean` | On / off | `true` |   | The run | Center data. |
|   | with_std | `with_std` | On / off | `true` |   | The run | Scale to unit variance. |
| Training semantics | Transform role | `transform_role` | Choice | `features` | `features`, `regression_target` | The run | Declare whether this scaler transforms features or continuous regression targets. |
| Fitted preprocessing state | Mode | `operation_mode` | Choice | `fit_transform` | `fit_transform`, `transform_only` | The run | Fit on this input or reuse saved training statistics. |
| Fitted preprocessing state | Save fitted state | `save_state` | On / off | `false` |   | The run | Persist mean and scale to an engine-managed project artifact for validation, test, and inference. |
| Fitted preprocessing state | State artifact path | `state_path` | File | (empty) | `*.cyxstate.json` | The run | Existing training .cyxstate.json artifact required by Transform Only. |
| Fitted preprocessing state | Allow state overwrite | `state_overwrite` | On / off | `false` |   | The run | Allow replacing an existing state artifact. Advanced. |

**Read by** says whether a run uses the setting (**The run**) or only the editor, a dialog or a view (**The editor only**).
